verdict.rationale: The pack contains no documented first-party export feature, bulk data download, or open-format export, and nothing about account portability or offboarding. The REST API can list connections, data stores and audit logs, and the MCP server can view scenarios. These are developer building blocks a user could use to build their own export, not an export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
